registryEvidence.custodian: 三河市自然资源和规划局 (Sanhe Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau)
registryEvidence.basis: The official Sanhe government information-disclosure guide names the bureau, gives its office address and contact details, and describes its information-disclosure responsibilities. The bureau's official 2025 report states that its work covers land-space planning, land use, cultivated-land protection, immovable-property registration and related natural-resources management.

officialSources.observation: Official Sanhe municipal portal; reachable by HTTP and links to the municipal natural-resources service entry, but no parcel viewer or parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the inspected portal shell.
